messages:
Ava (Product PM): Quick design review for the API Keys page. Goals: clearer empty state, rotation UX that prevents data loss, revoke copy, and a11y fixes. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/api-keys-v4

Sam (Design): Draft screens look good. Main asks: change CTA to 'Create API key' (action-first), show concise empty state blurb + 2 starter templates, and use 'Rotate key' everywhere instead of 'Regenerate'.

Jordan (Frontend): Callouts: 1) don't render full key in table by default. 2) Copy button should have aria-label="Copy API key" and a non-descriptive toast text (no key in DOM). 3) keyboard focus styles for rows need to be visible.

Kai (Accessibility): For the masked/reveal control: it must be reachable via keyboard, have role=\"button\" and aria-expanded toggling. When revealing, fire an announcement: "API key revealed, will hide in 10 seconds" via a polite live region. Also ensure contrast for badges meets AA.

Rohit (DevEx): UX suggestion: show masked value like ••••••-abcd and a tiny inline confirm when clicking Reveal: "Reveal key for 10s? [Reveal] [Cancel]" (inline, not modal). Emit events: api_key_reveal_request, api_key_revealed, api_key_reveal_cancel.

Maria (Security): Security notes: rotate should produce a one-time shown key and require confirmation that the user saved it (checkbox). Revoke must show strong copy: "Revoking this key will immediately break services that use it." Also require re-auth for admins if the session idle >15m. Add owner column for team keys.

Sam (Design): Microcopy tweaks for revoke modal: Title: "Revoke API key" Body: "This will immediately stop any requests using this key. You can rotate the key to temporarily replace it." Action button: "Revoke key" (destructive style). Add link: "See audit log" under the modal.

Ava (Product PM): Empty state: propose three cards: Server-to-server (recommended), Client-side (warning), Local dev (ephemeral). Each card has a one-click Create that pre-selects scopes. Copy: "Create your first API key to start integrating with Redwood Inference."

Jordan (Frontend): Implementation detail: for rotate flow, server returns new key once; client shows it in a read-only input with a checkbox "I have saved this key" that enables Finish. We'll set input autocomplete=off and use clipboard API for copy action with a fallback.

Rohit (DevEx): Analytics items: key_create_clicked, key_created, key_revealed, key_reveal_canceled, key_rotated_started, key_rotated_confirmed, key_revoked, empty_state_cta_click. Add instrumentation ticket.

Kai (Accessibility): Also add aria-describedby linking the masked token to the explanation tooltip: "Keys are masked to prevent accidental leaks. Use Reveal to see the value." Tooltip must be keyboard focusable.

Maria (Security): Copy behavior: toasts should never include the key. Rate-limit reveal/copy attempts and log them. For team keys, require an owner and show owner on hover.

Sam (Design): Small visual nits: make warning pill text larger, avoid yellow-on-white for small captions. Show scope badges inline in the row; on mobile collapse to stacked cards.

Ava (Product PM): Quick question on permissions: do we allow role-scoped keys now or later? I think minimal: Team vs Personal for GA, granular role-scoped later. Add a badge: "Team key" or "Personal key" with tooltip explaining differences.

Jordan (Frontend): Fine with Team vs Personal initially. We'll add a feature flag for per-scope keys later.

Rohit (DevEx): Empty-state tracking: track which starter template users select so we can optimize defaults. Also make the Create flow pre-fill recommended scopes to reduce friction.

Ava (Product PM): Can we A/B test empty state copy? One variant focusing on security-first ("Keep keys secret, rotate often"), another on speed ("Get started in 2 minutes").

Sam (Design): Good plan. Also agreed to use 'Rotate' as the verb across UI. Small copy tweak: change 'Show key' to 'Reveal key' everywhere.

audit-bot: Audit entry created: user=ava action=open_design_review ts=1744003215

Maria (Security): LGTM from security pending audit log link in modal. I'll sign off once the spec includes re-auth and logging requirements.

Ava (Product PM): Great. Sam will update Figma, Jordan and Rohit will queue tickets. Thanks all :rocket:
